description: This file contains utility functions for instrument monitoring within the JWST data analysis pipeline. It includes functions for filtering MAST query results to exclude ASIC tuning data, initializing monitors with logging, querying MAST for dark current data specific to instrument and detector configurations, and updating a monitor database table with execution details.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Database interface class provided by jwql for interacting with the monitor table.

methods.name: exclude_asic_tuning(mast_results)
methods.description: Filters out ASIC tuning files from MAST query results to ensure only valid instrument data is used.

methods.name: initialize_instrument_monitor(module)
methods.description: Sets up logging and captures start time for an instrument monitor run.

methods.name: mast_query_darks(instrument, aperture, start_date, end_date, readpatt=None)
methods.description: Queries MAST database for dark current data based on instrument, aperture, date range, and optionally readout pattern.

methods.name: update_monitor_table(module, start_time, log_file)
methods.description: Records the details of a monitor run into the database, including start/end times, status, and log file location.
